entry.title: New: Resolution 656 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A DONATION OF A SCORE BOARD WITH INSTALLATION TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION

The donation from West Side Hawai‘i Little League, with an estimated value of $11,000, would be installed at the William Charles Lunalilo Playground in Kailua-Kona.
